text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring grand prix, the Takarazuka Kinen, attracts the best of the best, with each runner seeking something different.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some desire proof that they stand on top of their generation. Others want a stepping stone abroad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But for Tosen Jordan, all that matters is beating Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That simple-minded determination gets a surprised laugh out of Nakayama Festa… and also lights a fire in her.
